examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The directory as Home places it: the section title over four product groups, framed with corner marks. Edit the props in the Controls panel — items without a title or a link are skipped, and a band with no linked item renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Three groups
examples.summary: Three groups fan out to three columns; between the small and the large breakpoints the third spans the row, so no empty cell shows the rule colour.

examples.name: With header
examples.summary: An eyebrow, the headline and one sentence under it over the directory, with an anchor so a page can link to the band with a #hash.
